subject: Results ledger: POC outcomes & advocate onboarding request
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@clearmart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Results ledger: POC outcomes & advocate onboarding request

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month. Quick recap attached (redwood-pilot-summary-CLRM-20260504.pdf) and a short ask: would ClearMart be willing to serve as a reference / short quote for a very small case highlight and a 15-minute advocacy onboarding call for our marketing team?

High-level outcomes from the 30-day POC (all numbers are from our telemetry and your test dataset):
- Average latency for 2k-token requests: 310ms (down from ~870ms in legacy infra; 64% reduction)
- Median token cost per inference: $0.0009/token (projected annualized savings ~37% vs baseline)
- Throughput: sustained 120 rps under mixed prompt distribution (20% higher than baseline)
- Topline accuracy/QA pass: 92% on the eval suite we ran together
- Integration time (engineering effort): ~3 engineer-weeks to go live on staging

Why we ask: short, attributable quotes (1–3 lines) and a quick 15-min call help us produce an accurate, high-quality case snippet that highlights your metrics without overclaiming. We always send drafts for review and anonymize any data you want kept internal.

Proposed next steps:
1) If you’re open, reply with a one-line quote or permission to publish the attached summary (we can redact any sensitive numbers).
2) Pick a 15-min slot next week for a quick synopsis call so marketing can capture the voice and correct wording.

Availability from our side: Tue 5/5 10:00–11:30 PT, Wed 5/6 14:00–16:30 PT, Thu 5/7 09:00–12:00 PT.

Appreciate it — and happy to make the request minimal.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-pilot-summary-CLRM-20260504.pdf (report, 4 pages)

From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@clearmart.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Results ledger: POC outcomes & advocate onboarding request

Hi Mateo —

Great summary — congrats to the team. The numbers look right based on our internal checks. ClearMart is happy to be a reference for Redwood for this engagement. A few small notes before anything goes public:
- Please do not publish per-customer revenue or exact cost-savings that tie back to identifiable customers; anonymized percentages are fine.
- We’d prefer the 92% QA pass be described as "~90% on our pilot evaluation suite" in any public materials.

Short quote you can use if helpful (feel free to tweak):
"Redwood’s inference platform delivered measurable latency and cost improvements during our pilot, enabling faster response times and predictable unit economics for production use."

I can do a 15-minute sync Wed 5/6 at 2:15 PM PT. Please send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Aisha Patel
VP Product, ClearMart
aisha.patel@clearmart.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0129

Thanks Aisha — really appreciate it.

Acknowledged on the anonymization requests; we’ll use "~90%" for the QA pass and will not include revenue-level figures. Marissa/Ben — can marketing/advocacy take Aisha’s quote verbatim or do we want to propose a tightened version?

Aisha — I’ve attached a one-page consent stub (consent-form-brief.pdf) that simply confirms permission to publish the short quote and the attached anonymized metrics. If that looks good, please sign and send back or reply with an approval line in your email.

Confirming Wed 5/6 14:15 PT — I’ll send a calendar invite for 15 minutes. Agenda: (1) capture preferred quote tone, (2) confirm anonymization/redactions, (3) quick permission note.

Thanks — I’ll mark the items and get the invite out.

Best,
Mateo
